stem.en: On a road trip, a family drives 200 km north in 3 h, then 200 km south in 2 h. What is the average speed for the whole trip, in km/h?

explanation.en: Total distance = 200 km + 200 km = 400 km. Total time = 3 h + 2 h = 5 h. Average speed = 400 / 5 = 80 km/h. The family ends where it started, so the average velocity is 0 km/h.

hints.en: Add up all the distance, then all the time.
